stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G013】近义词与多义词深度辨析：语义范围、褒贬色彩、技术定义与语域；【G018】状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 近义词与多义词深度辨析：语义范围、褒贬色彩、技术定义与语域
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 区分近义词与一词多义在语义范围、判断强度、褒贬色彩及学科专有定义上的差别。禁止把仅有部分重合的词当作完全同义词替换，禁止为堆砌大词而改变事实或判断强度。
rules: 测量与统计核心辨析：accuracy（准确度，接近真值） vs precision（精密度，重复测量一致）；reliable（稳定一致） vs valid（有效测量目标构念或推理成立）；efficacy（受控试验效力） vs effectiveness（真实场景效果）；equal（均等） vs equitable（按需求公平分配）；seasonality（固定日历周期） vs cyclicality（非固定周期的波动）；isotonic（保序的/等渗的） vs isotropic（各向同性的）。
褒贬与语域辨析：simple（简明清晰的） vs simplistic（过度简化的，贬义）；exploit structure（中性：利用结构） vs exploit workers（贬义：剥削）；manipulate a variable（中性：实验操纵自变量） vs falsify data（贬义：伪造数据）。
examples: An equitable allocation of resources may differ from an equal allocation.
Business cyclicality may involve expansions and contractions of varying duration, whereas seasonality follows a fixed calendar period.
An isotropic covariance function depends on distance rather than direction, whereas isotonic regression enforces a monotonicity constraint.
common_errors: 把 suggest/indicate 机械替换为 prove/demonstrate 导致过度推断。
混淆形近学术词：adapt/adopt, adverse/averse, discrete/discreet, temporal/temporary, stationary/stationery, isotonic/isotropic。

grammar_instruction.name: 状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握从属连词（although, whereas, while, provided that, because, in that）、介词短语（despite, in spite of, due to, prior to, in light of, in the absence of）与连接副词（nevertheless, nonetheless, consequently, conversely）之间的句法转换。
rules: 让步压缩：Although the approach has limitations -> Albeit with limitations / Despite its limitations（严禁写 *despite of）。
条件限定：provided that / as long as + 完整分句 <-> subject to / under + 名词短语。
对照结构：whereas / while 连接两个对称分句（The first model uses monthly data, whereas the second uses daily data）。
examples: The approach is informative, albeit with limitations.
The result applies provided that the assumptions hold.
The estimate remains uncertain despite the larger sample.
common_errors: 混淆介词与连词：*despite the sample is large。
while 表对比时与时间含义发生歧义（在时序/并发场景中表对比优先用 whereas）。

grammar_instruction.name: 适度名词化（Nominalization）、复杂名词短语与动词活力平衡
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 名词化可将前句的过程浓缩为后句主语（如 The relaxation of this assumption...），实现紧凑衔接；但绝不能认为“名词化越多越学术”，过度名词化会导致句子僵化、头重脚轻。
rules: 用“The + 派生名词 + of + 核心对象”打包已知过程作主语，谓语仍使用清晰有力的动词（The elimination of duplicate entries reduced the file size）。
当主语和宾语都已是长抽象名词时，中间谓语直接用强动词（affects, constrains, clarifies），不要写 *conducts an influence on。
examples: The emergence of new devices changed the monitoring procedure.
The quantification of uncertainty is central to this analysis.
common_errors: 僵尸名词堆砌（Zombie Nouns）：*The implementation of the reduction of parameters was carried out（应直接写 We reduced the number of parameters）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 消融实验（Ablation Study）与基线公平对比（Fair Baseline Comparison）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To disentangle the contribution of [Component A] from [Component B], we compare the full model against a conventional baseline under comparable conditions.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于实验与消融分析章节，严谨剥离各模块的独立贡献，避免只挑有利指标汇报（selective reporting）。
examples: Every proposed method should be compared against a relevant baseline under comparable conditions.
